assistanceEvents.reason: The pinned CLI rejected the frozen anonymous-local invocation and current help hid the assigned port flags.
assistanceEvents.informationUsed: Pinned Convex CLI source confirmed that local-cloud-port and local-site-port remain accepted after local selection.
assistanceEvents.impact: Preserved assigned ports 3345 and 3346 without a custom backend wrapper.

assistanceEvents.reason: The fresh local target needed three attributable identities for headless native clients.
assistanceEvents.informationUsed: A prior Convex arm suggested the CLI's native local admin acting-identity path; the capability was independently verified in the pinned client source.
assistanceEvents.impact: Alice, Bob, and Mallory used distinct Convex development identities; no implementation code was copied.

failures.command: Initial remote bootstrap in a non-login SSH shell
failures.result: Node and npm were absent from PATH; no provider target or state was created.
failures.resolution: Used the machine fleet's Volta installation through an explicit worktree-local environment.

failures.command: convex dev --local --once --configure new with fixed ports

failures.result: Failed because no local target existed.
Required account login despite the local-agent documentation describing login-free anonymous development.
failures.resolution: A fresh non-interactive convex dev --once provisioned anonymously.

failures.result: A generated control secret was present in process argv and the backend/site ports bound to wildcard addresses.
failures.resolution: Paused metrics, contained and deleted r1, rotated to r2, reproduced the provider defect, and continued only as an untimed extension.

failures.result: Printing full child argv propagated the provider-local control secret into orchestration output.
failures.resolution: Rotated the target and changed every later process proof to PID, executable, and redacted flag names only.

failures.result: Nested jq quoting caused a shell syntax error before either build or acceptance ran.
failures.resolution: Reran the command with a simpler quoted jq expression.

failures.command: git commit in the fresh remote repository
failures.result: Git refused because the isolated repository had no author name or email configured; the index was unchanged.
failures.resolution: Configured repository-local author identity from the assigned base commit and retried without changing global machine state.
